briefdescription.para: Restore the state machine to a previously created checkpoint.

detaileddescription.para: Rollback To Checkpoint.

The state and current version are overwritten with the values captured at checkpoint creation time. Checkpoints newer than id are removed from the in-memory list. The restoration is recorded in the transaction log and, if a history logger is attached, emitted as a "checkpoint_rollback" event.

IDEMPOTENCY: Calling this method multiple times with the same checkpoint ID will return true on all calls, but the actual rollback operation is only performed once. Subsequent calls are logged as idempotent and do not modify state.

id
Identifier of the target checkpoint (returned by createCheckpoint()).
true if a checkpoint with the given id was found and applied; false if no such checkpoint exists or was never rolled back to. Returns true for idempotent repeat calls to the same checkpoint.
id
Input parameter.
True when the operation succeeds.
Calls: lock(), has_value(), value(), std::chrono::system_clock::now(), LOG_WARN(), load(), std::to_string(), push_back().

briefdescription.para: Perform rollback with a fallback strategy for failure handling.

detaileddescription.para: Rollback To Checkpoint With Fallback.

When rollback to checkpoint_id fails, applies the fallback_strategy:
IMMEDIATE_ABORT: returns false immediately (fail-fast)
PARTIAL_CONTINUE: attempts recovery and returns true (optimistic)
DEFER: queues the rollback for retry and returns false
The decision enables coordinated managers to handle per-node rollback failures without cascading the failure across the cluster.

checkpoint_id
Target checkpoint
fallback_strategy
Strategy to apply on failure
true if rollback succeeded or was deferred with PARTIAL_CONTINUE

Identifier of the checkpoint.
fallback_strategy
Input parameter.
True when the operation succeeds.
Calls: lock(), rollbackToCheckpoint(), push_back(), LOG_WARN(), LOG_ERROR().
